# Diagnostic code registry (MOD-003).
#
# Every diagnostic code that has been merged to main, and therefore shipped by
# the next release, is listed here as `<code> <status> <meaning>`:
#
#   status   active   the code is emitted by its module and documented in
#                     docs/SPEC.md
#            retired  the check was removed; the code stays reserved and must
#                     never be emitted again, but keeps its row in docs/SPEC.md
#                     marked retired
#   meaning  a short stable slug naming what the code reports; it never changes
#
# This file is append-only. Adding a code appends an `active` line; removing a
# check flips its status to `retired`. A line is never deleted, renumbered or
# given a new meaning. src/result/codes_lifecycle_test.go enforces this against
# the sources, docs/SPEC.md and the registry as shipped by the latest release
# tag (git history), so a deleted or rewritten line fails the build.
